caldwell--eastern-standard.description: One of the three blends with which Robert Caldwell launched the Caldwell Collection in 2014, Eastern Standard is rolled at Tabacalera Ventura in the Dominican Republic from an Ecuadorian hybrid Connecticut wrapper, a Dominican Habano binder and filler that includes Dominican Criollo '98 and Corojo ligero. Creamy and woody, it shows cedar, coffee, citrus and nuts.

thirds.notes: Cream, lemon-like citrus and black pepper, with cocoa, cedar, leather and a hint of hay in some smokes.
Pepper and wood merge into a sweet-spiced cedar, with cream, coffee and a soft chestnut or walnut note.
Cedar and cream alternate, with dark coffee, earth and nuts underneath and a clean finish.

caldwell--the-king-is-dead.description: One of Robert Caldwell's earliest blends, The King Is Dead is a Dominican puro built around Negrito: a 2008 Negrito wrapper over a Dominican Corojo binder, with Corojo ligero, Negrito viso and HVA 20/20 in the filler, made at Tabacalera William Ventura. Milk chocolate runs through it, with coffee, cedar and pepper and a slow build in strength.

thirds.notes: Milk chocolate and roasted coffee with honeyed sweetness, oak and cedar, and pepper that starts red and turns black.
Coffee and chocolate settle in with sweet cream and cinnamon; the spice eases as the strength begins to climb.
Woody notes and black pepper grow, with coffee, cocoa and toasted peanut; the close is stronger and drier.

caldwell--long-live-the-king.description: Part of the Caldwell Collection launched in 2014, Long Live the King is a Corojo-centered blend made at Tabacalera Ventura: Dominican Corojo wrapper and binder, with Dominican Corojo ligero, Nicaraguan Habano ligero and a touch of Peruvian Pelo de Oro in the filler. Spiced and citrusy at first, it grows strong and peppery.

thirds.notes: Citrus and exotic spice with nuts, cedar, leather and cream; red and white pepper sit lightly on top.
Strength and body climb; leather, pepper and espresso lead, with cinnamon and some chocolate and raisin.
Peppery ligero and leather remain, the nuttiness holds and a mineral, earthy finish arrives.
